blocks.css: /* appUI primitives and semantic roles. Components use semantic roles. */
/* Generated from config/colors.json. Run npm run colors:generate. */
/* appUI type scale: one optical rhythm across 13 roles and four weights. */
.ui-button__label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 4px; }

.ui-button__busy-spinner { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.85); transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, transform var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease); }
.ui-button__leading-slot { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; }
.ui-button[data-variant='outline'] { border: 1px solid var(--accent-strong); background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--accent-label); }
.ui-button[data-variant='solid'] { background: var(--color-accent-600); color: var(--on-accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-action); }
.ui-button[data-variant='primary'] { overflow: hidden; color: var(--on-accent); background: var(--gradient-action); box-shadow: var(--shadow-action); }

.ui-button[data-variant='primary']::before { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--gradient-action-hover); opacity: 0; content: ''; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease; }
.ui-button[data-variant='secondary'] { border: 1px solid var(--border-control); background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-button[data-variant='danger'] { color: white; background: var(--danger-strong); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14); }

.ui-button:active:not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled="true"]) { transform: scale(.98); transition-duration: var(--motion-fast), var(--motion-fast), var(--motion-fast), var(--motion-fast), var(--motion-fast), var(--motion-standard); }
.ui-button:disabled, .ui-button[aria-disabled="true"]:not([data-loading]) { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

.ui-close-button { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); transition: color var(--motion-fast) ease, background var(--motion-fast) ease; }

.ui-icon-button { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; min-height: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); transition: background var(--motion-fast) ease, border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease, transform var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease); }
.ui-icon-button__glyph { position: relative; display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.ui-icon-button__glyph > span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.ui-icon-button[data-variant='ghost'] { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }

.ui-icon-button__badge { position: absolute; top: -5px; right: -5px; display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 15px; height: 15px; padding: 0 3px; border: 1px solid var(--surface-base); border-radius: 99px; background: #ed2847; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; line-height: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-icon-button:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-strong); }

.ui-button-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }

.ui-button-group__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; flex: none; height: 34px; min-width: 41px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease; }
.ui-carousel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; }
.ui-carousel__track { position: relative; display: flex; width: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-carousel__dots { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 10px; }
.ui-carousel__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--border-control); transition: width .18s ease, background .18s ease; }
.ui-checkbox { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; color: var(--text-main); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }

.ui-checkbox__label { color: var(--text-main);    font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-checkbox__box { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-base); color: white; box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; }

.ui-checkbox__box[data-marked] { border-color: var(--accent-strong); background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--accent-strong), var(--accent-hover)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3), var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-checkbox__tick { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 0; animation: ui-check-draw .2s ease-out both; }

.ui-checkbox-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 70px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease; }

.ui-checkbox-card__copy strong { color: var(--text-strong);     font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-checkbox-card__copy > span { color: var(--text-muted);    font-size: var(--text-body-regular); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-regular--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-regular--letter-spacing); }

.ui-announcement { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); }
.ui-announcement__top { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 20px; }
.ui-announcement__title { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.012em; }

.ui-avatar { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 32px; height: 32px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); vertical-align: middle; text-align: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; }
.ui-avatar img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.ui-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 20px; height: 19px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted);    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;  font-size: var(--text-caption-1-semibold); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--letter-spacing); }

.ui-badge[data-variant='label'], .ui-badge[data-variant='pill'] { flex: none; min-width: 0; height: 18px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--badge-neutral-bg); color: var(--badge-neutral-text); font-family: var(--font-inter), sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: .25px; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-badge[data-variant='pill'] { height: 22px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-soft); }
.ui-badge[data-color='primary'] { background: var(--accent-strong); color: white; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.14); }

.ui-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 22px; height: 20px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--border-control); color: var(--text-muted); font-family: inherit;    white-space: nowrap;  font-size: var(--text-caption-1-semibold); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-1-semibold--letter-spacing); }

.ui-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--chip-text); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-chip[data-variant='caption'] { min-height: 24px; padding-top: 4px; padding-bottom: 4px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-status-dot { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot-halo); }
.ui-status-dot > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot-core); }

.ui-breadcrumb { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none;  font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-1-medium--letter-spacing); }
.ui-breadcrumb ol { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: max-content; min-width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

.ui-breadcrumb__item { display: flex; align-items: center; flex: none; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); }

.ui-breadcrumb__item > a, .ui-breadcrumb__item > button, .ui-breadcrumb__item > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 25px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-breadcrumb__item > a:hover, .ui-breadcrumb__item > button:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); }

.ui-date-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; }

.ui-date-popover { z-index: var(--layer-popover); max-width: calc(100vw - 24px); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface-canvas); box-shadow: 0 17px 45px rgba(20,30,47,.14), 0 1px 4px rgba(20,30,47,.05); outline: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
@keyframes ui-date-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px) scale(.99); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
.ui-date-presets { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; flex: none; width: 128px; padding: 7px 3px 0 4px; }

.ui-date-presets button { min-height: 36px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-date-presets button:hover, .ui-date-presets button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-strong); }
.ui-month-panel { flex: none; width: 326px; min-height: 315px; padding: 11px 12px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-month-panel__heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 5px; height: 29px; margin-bottom: 13px; }
.ui-month-panel__heading strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-month-panel__nav, .ui-month-panel__spacer { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 27px; height: 27px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-month-panel__weekday { height: 32px; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-month-panel__cell { width: 42px; height: 43px; padding: 0; color: var(--text-strong); text-align: center; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; cursor: pointer; }
.ui-calendar-day { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 35px; height: 35px; margin: auto; border-radius: 7px; }
.ui-date-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; min-height: 47px; padding: 10px 8px 0; }
.ui-date-footer__summary { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }

.ui-date-chip { width: 94px; height: 31px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ui-date-day-count { padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-scheduler__details { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: start; gap: 4px; padding: 15px 10px; }

.ui-scheduler__avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-scheduler__details h3 { margin: 16px 0 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 20px; line-height: 24px; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-scheduler__details p { margin: 5px 0 15px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
.ui-scheduler__info { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 12px; }

.ui-scheduler__times { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; min-width: 0; padding: 13px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-scheduler__timezone { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-scheduler__format { display: flex; align-items: center; align-self: start; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-scheduler__format button { min-width: 43px; height: 25px; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-scheduler__format button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-scheduler__slots { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 5px; height: 227px; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-scheduler__slots button { min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-scheduler__slots button:hover, .ui-scheduler__slots button[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--accent-strong); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.ui-image-artwork { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: inherit; object-fit: cover; }

.ui-app-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; flex: none; width: 260px; height: 100%; min-height: 500px; overflow: hidden; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--docs-sidebar, var(--surface-canvas)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sidebar); transition: width .22s ease, padding .22s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar__top, .ui-app-sidebar__bottom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.ui-app-sidebar__top > .ui-app-sidebar__nav { min-height: 0; overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-app-sidebar__head { position: relative; height: 34px; transition: height .25s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__identity { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); text-align: left;   white-space: nowrap; transition: transform .25s ease;  font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-app-sidebar__identity > span:last-child { overflow: hidden; max-width: 150px; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transition: max-width .25s ease, opacity .16s ease, filter .25s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__collapse { position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 27px; height: 27px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); transform: translateX(0); transition: right .25s ease, transform .25s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__search { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); transform-origin: left center; transition: opacity .16s ease, transform .25s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar__search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; }

.ui-app-sidebar__search-rail { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translateX(-50%); transition: opacity .16s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar__nav { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 4px; padding-inline: 2px; min-width: 0; }

.ui-app-sidebar__nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 36px; min-width: 0; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: left; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); white-space: nowrap; transition: width .25s ease, gap .25s ease, background-color .15s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar__nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--gradient-action); color: white; box-shadow: var(--shadow-nav-selected); }

.ui-app-sidebar[data-selection-variant='neutral'] .ui-app-sidebar__nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-app-sidebar__nav-label { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; max-width: 170px; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transition: max-width .25s ease, opacity .16s ease, filter .25s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar__badge { min-width: 25px; max-width: 60px; overflow: hidden; opacity: 1; transition: max-width .25s ease, min-width .25s ease, opacity .16s ease, padding .25s ease; }
.ui-app-sidebar[data-selection-variant='accent'] .ui-app-sidebar__nav-item[aria-current='page'] .ui-badge { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: white; box-shadow: none; }
.ui-app-sidebar__announcement { max-height: 150px; overflow: hidden; opacity: 1; transition: max-height .25s ease, opacity .16s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__user { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; transition: gap .25s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__user > span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; max-width: 190px; overflow: hidden; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transition: max-width .25s ease, opacity .16s ease, filter .25s ease; }

.ui-app-sidebar__user strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-strong); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;    font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-app-sidebar__user small { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;   font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-1-medium--letter-spacing); }
.ui-app-sidebar[data-collapsed] .ui-app-sidebar__identity { width: 100%; justify-content: center; gap: 0; transform: translateY(36px); }

.ui-app-sidebar[data-collapsed] .ui-app-sidebar__identity > span:last-child, .ui-app-sidebar[data-collapsed] .ui-app-sidebar__nav-label, .ui-app-sidebar[data-collapsed] .ui-app-sidebar__user > span:last-child { max-width: 0; opacity: 0; filter: blur(3px); }
.ui-app-sidebar button:focus-visible, .ui-app-sidebar a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }
.ui-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; }
.ui-divider__content { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; max-width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; text-align: center; }
.ui-divider[data-variant='double'] { min-height: 42px; justify-content: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-divider[data-variant='fill'] { min-height: 40px; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-muted); }

.ui-dropdown-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease), color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease); }

.ui-dropdown-popover { z-index: var(--layer-popover); width: 266px; max-width: calc(100vw - 24px); padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-overlay); box-shadow: var(--shadow-menu); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }

.ui-dropdown-popover { --dropdown-origin-x: left; --dropdown-origin-y: top; opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0); transform-origin: var(--dropdown-origin-x) var(--dropdown-origin-y); transition: opacity .15s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1), transform .15s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1), filter .15s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1); }
.ui-animated-height { min-width: 0; overflow: clip; transition: height var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease); }

.ui-message[data-variant='bubble'] { width: auto; max-width: min(540px,88%); padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-conversation { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.ui-conversation__body { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }

.ui-conversation__viewport { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; overflow-anchor: none; scrollbar-width: none; scrollbar-color: var(--border-strong) transparent; }
.ui-conversation__content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 18px; min-width: 0; min-height: 100%; padding: 24px; }
.ui-conversation__jump { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 20px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 1; animation: ui-stream-in 160ms ease; }
.ui-conversation__footer { flex: none; min-width: 0; padding: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-base); }

.docs-stream-line { margin: 0; min-height: 72px; color: var(--text-main); font-size: var(--text-body-regular); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-regular--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-regular--letter-spacing); }
.docs-message-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; }
.ui-chat-starter__thread .ui-conversation__viewport { display: flex; flex-direction: column; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-chat-starter__messages > .ui-message { max-width: min(540px,88%); padding: 11px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-chat-starter__messages .ui-message__content { font-size: var(--text-body-regular); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-regular--font-weight); }

.ui-agent-progress { width: min(341px, 100%); min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); transition: min-height var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease); }
.ui-agent-progress__head { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 24px; padding-left: 4px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

.ui-agent-progress__head button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease; }
.ui-agent-progress__overall { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.ui-agent-progress__overall circle:last-child { stroke: var(--text-muted); stroke-dasharray: 44; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset var(--motion-settle) var(--motion-ease-soft); }
.ui-agent-progress__steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; overflow: hidden; }

.ui-agent-progress__step { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 32px; flex: none; overflow: hidden; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: left; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); white-space: nowrap; opacity: 1; transition: padding var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease-soft), color var(--motion-settle) ease; }

.ui-agent-progress__step::before { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: inherit; content: ''; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) ease; }
.ui-agent-progress__label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ui-agent-progress__label-text { position: relative; display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; vertical-align: middle; }
.ui-agent-progress__strike { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform-origin: left center; pointer-events: none; }
.ui-agent-progress__step small { flex: none; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-agent-progress__mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-agent-progress__mark > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 14px; height: 14px; }

.ui-agent-progress__step[data-status='complete'] .ui-agent-progress__mark { border-color: var(--border-control); background: var(--border-control); color: var(--text-muted); transition: background var(--motion-standard) ease, border-color var(--motion-standard) ease; }

.ui-agent-progress__mark svg circle:last-child { stroke: var(--text-muted); stroke-dasharray: 44; stroke-dashoffset: 11; stroke-linecap: round; transform: rotate(-90deg); transform-origin: center; animation: ui-progress-fill var(--ui-step-duration) linear both; }
.ui-agent-progress__mark svg[data-controlled] circle:last-child { animation: none; transition: stroke-dashoffset .18s ease; }

.ui-agent-thinking { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 22px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-body-regular); font-weight: var(--text-body-regular--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-regular--letter-spacing); }
.ui-agent-thinking__indicator { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: none; color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-agent-thinking__dots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 3px); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 3px); gap: 2px; place-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.ui-agent-thinking__dots i { display: block; width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: .24; }

.ui-agent-thinking__stars i { position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: currentColor; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 62% 38%, 100% 50%, 62% 62%, 50% 100%, 38% 62%, 0 50%, 38% 38%); animation: ui-thinking-twinkle 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.ui-agent-thinking__infinity { width: 26px; height: 18px; overflow: visible; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.6; }
.ui-agent-thinking__infinity-head { stroke: currentColor; stroke-dasharray: 18 82; animation: ui-thinking-infinity 2.3s linear infinite; }

.ui-agent-thinking__orb { position: relative; display: block; width: 19px; height: 19px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 36%, white), transparent 56%), color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 32%, transparent), 0 0 9px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent); }
.ui-agent-thinking__orb i { position: absolute; display: block; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.ui-agent-thinking__orb i:nth-child(1) { width: 14px; height: 7px; top: 2px; left: -1px; opacity: .75; filter: blur(2px); animation: ui-thinking-orb-a 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ui-agent-thinking__orb i:nth-child(2) { width: 9px; height: 13px; right: 0; bottom: -2px; opacity: .55; filter: blur(2px); animation: ui-thinking-orb-b 2.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.ui-agent-thinking__orb i:nth-child(3) { width: 5px; height: 5px; top: 8px; left: 7px; opacity: .9; box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor; animation: ui-thinking-orb-core 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }

.ui-agent-thinking__label--shimmer { background: linear-gradient(95deg, var(--text-muted) 20%, var(--text-strong) 50%, var(--text-muted) 80%); background-size: 240% auto; background-clip: text; color: transparent; animation: ui-thinking-shimmer 2.4s linear infinite; }

.ui-agent-thinking time { color: var(--text-subtle); min-inline-size: 36px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-caption-2-regular); font-weight: var(--text-caption-2-regular--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-caption-2-regular--line-height); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-2-regular--letter-spacing); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
@keyframes ui-thinking-wave { 0%, 65%, 100% { opacity: .22; transform: scale(.8); } 28% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.45); } }
@keyframes ui-thinking-orbit-dot { 0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: .2; transform: scale(.8); } 16% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.6); } 32% { opacity: .55; transform: scale(1.1); } }
@keyframes ui-thinking-twinkle { 0%, 100% { opacity: .24; transform: scale(.6); } 45% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes ui-thinking-orb-a { to { transform: translate(7px, 8px) rotate(70deg) scale(1.2); } }
@keyframes ui-thinking-orb-b { to { transform: translate(-7px, -7px) rotate(-55deg) scale(1.25); } }
@keyframes ui-block-reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

children.css: .ui-agent-progress, .ui-agent-progress__overall circle:last-child, .ui-agent-progress__mark svg circle:last-child, .ui-agent-thinking__indicator *, .ui-agent-thinking__label { animation: none; transition: none; }

blocks.css: .ui-auth-card { display: grid; width: min(400px,100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }
.ui-auth-card__artwork { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--accent-soft); }
.ui-auth-card__content h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 21px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.ui-auth-card__content > p { margin: 6px 0 23px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 19px; }

.ui-auth-card__password > button { position: absolute; right: 9px; bottom: 5px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-auth-card__options { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.ui-auth-card__options > button, .ui-auth-card__switch button, .ui-auth-card__back { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 11px; }

.ui-auth-card__submit, .ui-auth-card__verify > button { min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--gradient-action); color: white; box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: filter .16s ease, transform .16s ease; }
.ui-auth-card__divider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 24px 0 18px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }
.ui-auth-card__switch { margin-top: 18px; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; font-size: 11px; }
.ui-auth-card__back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 24px; }

.ui-composer__panel { padding: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 19px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); transition: border-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease; }
.ui-composer__entry { display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 6px; min-height: 39px; }

.ui-composer__entry > textarea { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-height: 120px; min-height: 31px; padding: 7px 3px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); resize: none; outline: none; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }

.ui-composer__add, .ui-composer__voice, .ui-composer__send { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); transition: background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease, transform .16s ease; }
.ui-composer__entry .ui-select__trigger { min-height: 30px; border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
.ui-composer__status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 5px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 10px; }
.ui-composer__status > span:not(.ui-composer__status-spacer) { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

.ui-composer-attachments__tile, .ui-composer-attachments__add { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 56px; height: 56px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-composer-attachments__tile > img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.ui-composer-attachments__tile > svg, .ui-composer-attachments__tile > span, .ui-composer-attachments__tile > small { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.ui-composer-attachments__tile > span { max-width: 46px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 8px; }
.ui-composer-attachments__tile > small { position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface-overlay); font-size: 8px; }

.ui-composer-attachments__tile > button { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 2px; right: 2px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 17px; height: 17px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-overlay); color: var(--text-main); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .16s ease; }
.ui-composer-attachments__input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.ui-composer-panel .ui-composer__status { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 8px; left: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; background: var(--surface-muted); }

.ui-composer-panel__permissions button { min-height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: capitalize; font-size: 11px; }
.ui-data-table { width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-data-table__toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 58px; padding: 9px 12px; }

.ui-data-table__filters select { max-width: 125px; min-height: 33px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-data-table__search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; width: 158px; min-height: 33px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-data-table__search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-data-table table { width: 100%; min-width: 610px; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-data-table th, .ui-data-table td { height: 43px; padding: 8px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-data-table th > button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: inherit; }
.ui-data-table tbody tr:hover, .ui-data-table tbody tr[data-selected] { background: var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-data-table__foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; min-height: 51px; padding: 8px 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-data-table__foot > span { color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-notification-center { width: min(430px,100%); padding: 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }
.ui-notification-center header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.ui-notification-center header h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 16px; line-height: 23px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-notification-center header p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }

.ui-notification-center header button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-notification-center__tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 2px; margin: 16px 0 10px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-notification-center__tabs button { min-height: 29px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-notification-center__tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-notification-center__tabs span { margin-left: 3px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 9px; }
.ui-notification-center__list { display: grid; gap: 7px; max-height: 470px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 2px; }

.ui-notification-center__item { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 9px; min-height: 87px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-notification-center__avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); }
.ui-notification-center__copy strong { display: block; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-notification-center__copy p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 17px; }

.ui-notification-center__copy button { min-height: 25px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 10px; }
.ui-notification-center__copy button:first-child { border-color: transparent; background: var(--accent-strong); color: white; }
.ui-notification-center__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 10px; }
.ui-notification-center__meta button { width: 8px; height: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-strong); }
.ui-notification-center__empty { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 40px 10px; color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-questionnaire { width: min(630px,100%); padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 19px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-questionnaire header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 19px; }
.ui-questionnaire header > span { color: var(--text-subtle); font-family: var(--font-mono-source),monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .07em; }

.ui-questionnaire header button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 21px; height: 21px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-questionnaire__question h2 { margin: 3px 0 11px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; }

.ui-questionnaire__options > label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 58px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface-base); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease, transform .16s ease; }
.ui-questionnaire__options > label > span { display: grid; gap: 3px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.ui-questionnaire__options input:not(.ui-questionnaire__other) { width: 15px; height: 15px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent-strong); }
.ui-questionnaire__other { width: 100%; max-width: 260px; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-questionnaire footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin-top: 12px; }
.ui-questionnaire__steps { display: flex; flex: 1; gap: 3px; overflow-x: auto; }

.ui-questionnaire footer > button { flex: none; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-questionnaire footer .ui-questionnaire__next { border-color: transparent; background: var(--gradient-action); color: white; }
/* Keep intrinsic grid content inside narrow documentation and template containers. */
/* Composer layout: compact pill and two-row panel share the same controls. */
/* Streaming activity lives directly in the conversation canvas. */
/* Density and type in dashboard and form blocks */
.ui-agent-avatar { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.ui-agent-avatar > svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.ui-agent-avatar > .ui-agent-face { position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 28%; width: 55%; height: 48%; }

.ui-agent-creator { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: min(356px, 100%); height: 760px; min-width: 0; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); font-size: var(--text-body-regular); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); font-weight: 400; }
.ui-agent-creator__header { flex: none; height: 32px; padding-top: 16px; text-align: center; }

.ui-agent-creator__header h2 { overflow: hidden; max-width: 260px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-agent-creator__scroll { position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 0 8px 16px 4px; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-agent-creator__emotions { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 30px; left: 50%; width: 268px; height: 268px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); touch-action: pan-y; cursor: grab; }

.ui-agent-creator__emotions button { position: absolute; top: calc(50% + var(--face-y)); left: calc(50% + var(--face-x)); display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--agent-color); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; }
.ui-agent-creator__portrait { position: absolute; top: 79px; left: 50%; width: 168px; height: 168px; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; }
.ui-agent-creator__shapes { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 235px 0 0; touch-action: pan-y; cursor: grab; }

.ui-agent-creator__shapes button { position: absolute; top: calc(94px + var(--shape-y)); left: calc(50% + var(--shape-x)); display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: top 360ms cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), left 360ms cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; }

.ui-agent-creator__colors { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; margin: 15px 8px 0; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 999px; }

blocks.css: .ui-template-board-application { width: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 21px; background: var(--surface-base); }

blocks.css: .ui-ai-chat button { transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; }

.ui-ai-chat__sidebar { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-raised); }

.ui-ai-chat__welcome > div { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px; }

.ui-ai-chat__inspector { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-base); opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateX(0); transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s; }

.ui-ai-chat[data-panel-closed] .ui-ai-chat__inspector { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(12px); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s linear var(--motion-standard); }
.ui-ai-chat__tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; height: 42px; flex: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }

.ui-ai-chat__tabs button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); }

.ui-ai-chat__change-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); font-weight: var(--text-body-2-medium--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-body-2-medium--line-height); }

.ui-ai-chat__change-summary strong, .ui-ai-chat__change-summary em { flex: none; font-size: var(--text-body-regular); font-weight: var(--text-body-regular--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); }
.ui-ai-chat__file-list { display: grid; gap: 3px; flex: none; padding: 5px; }
.ui-ai-chat__browser { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; padding: 10px 0; }
.ui-ai-chat__browser-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 8px 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; }

.ui-ai-chat__browser-toolbar strong { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-ai-chat__browser-toolbar button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); }

.ui-ai-chat__browser-page { display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: start; gap: 13px; flex: 1; padding: 30px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 12px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 75% 24%, var(--accent-soft), transparent 42%), var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-ai-chat__browser-page h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 26px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.ui-ai-chat__browser-page p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }

.ui-ai-chat__browser-page button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; margin-top: 5px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-strong); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-ai-chat__panel-scrim { position: absolute; z-index: 11; inset: 0; border: 0; background: rgb(8 12 18 / .25); }
.ui-ai-chat__project > button[aria-current='page'] { transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease; }
@keyframes ui-ai-chat-message-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); filter: blur(2px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); } }

/* Navigation becomes a drawer below 1024px; the inspector below 1280px.
   The live iframe uses these same rules at its real viewport width. */

children.css: .ui-ai-chat__inspector { position: absolute; z-index: 12; top: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: min(410px, calc(100% - 24px)); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(12px); pointer-events: none; }

.ui-ai-chat[data-overlay-panel-open] .ui-ai-chat__inspector { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateX(0); pointer-events: auto; transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s; }
.ui-ai-chat__mobile-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: none; min-height: 60px; padding: 12px; }

.ui-ai-chat__mobile-header button { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }

.ui-ai-chat > .ui-ai-chat__sidebar { position: absolute; z-index: 20; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; width: min(260px, calc(100% - 24px)); visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(calc(-100% - 24px)); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), visibility 0s linear .25s; }

.ui-ai-chat__close-navigation { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); }
.ui-ai-chat__scrim { position: absolute; z-index: 19; inset: 0; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: rgb(8 12 18 / .35); }

blocks.css: .ui-image-workbench { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; height: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-base); transition: grid-template-columns var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease); }

.ui-image-workbench__conversation { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-raised); transition: margin-right var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease); }
.ui-image-workbench__topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 47px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; }
.ui-image-workbench__topbar strong { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-main); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-image-workbench__topbar button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; margin-left: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-image-workbench__topbar button:hover, .ui-image-workbench__panel-actions button:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-strong); }

.ui-image-workbench__thread { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 22px; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 24px 16px 14px; scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-image-workbench__prompt { max-width: min(390px, 87%); margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); font-size: var(--text-body-regular); font-weight: 400; line-height: var(--text-body-regular--line-height); animation: ui-image-prompt-in var(--motion-settle) var(--motion-ease-soft) both; }

.ui-image-workbench__generation { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-self: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; width: 205px; height: 222px; flex: none; overflow: hidden; padding: 12px; border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); animation: ui-image-card-in var(--motion-settle) var(--motion-ease-soft) both; }
.ui-image-workbench__generation > span:last-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.ui-image-workbench__generation > span:last-child button { margin-left: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-image-workbench__pulse { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-strong); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-soft); animation: ui-image-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }

.ui-image-workbench__orb { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(11, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(11, 1fr); gap: 4px; align-self: center; width: 166px; height: 166px; place-items: center; mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 0 22%, #000 24% 68%, transparent 73%); transform: rotate(-12deg); }
.ui-image-workbench__orb i { width: 2.5px; height: 2.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-label); animation: ui-image-orb 1.75s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

.ui-image-workbench__result { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 10px; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; background-size: cover; animation: ui-image-result-in .55s var(--motion-ease-soft) both; }
.ui-image-workbench__failure { display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: 1; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-image-workbench__panel-scrim { position: absolute; z-index: 40; inset: 0; border: 0; background: rgb(8 12 18 / .25); }

.ui-image-workbench__panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-base); opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s; }

.ui-image-workbench[data-panel-closed] .ui-image-workbench__panel { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s linear var(--motion-standard); }
.ui-image-workbench__panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 3px; min-height: 47px; padding: 0 5px; }
.ui-image-workbench__panel-header > div:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; gap: 2px; }

.ui-image-workbench__panel-header [role='tab'] { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 31px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 17px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-image-workbench__panel-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; flex: none; }

.ui-image-workbench__panel-actions button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 25px; height: 27px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 17px; }

.ui-image-workbench__gallery { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; align-content: start; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 5px 5px; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-image-workbench__gallery-column { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; }

.ui-image-workbench__tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0;  overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-muted); text-align: left; animation: ui-image-tile-in .48s var(--motion-ease-soft) both; }

.ui-image-workbench__art, .ui-image-workbench__style-art { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: cover; transition: transform var(--motion-settle) var(--motion-ease-soft); }

.ui-image-workbench__tile-label { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 25px 7px 7px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgb(0 0 0 / .58)); color: #fff; font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, transform var(--motion-fast) ease; }
.ui-image-workbench__styles p { margin: 5px 0 16px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; }
.ui-image-workbench__styles > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }

.ui-image-workbench__styles > div > button { display: grid; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--motion-fast) ease, transform var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease); }
.ui-image-workbench__styles > div > button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-image-workbench__styles > div > button[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--accent-strong); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.ui-image-workbench__styles strong { overflow: hidden; padding: 0 3px 2px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-image-workbench__lightbox { position: absolute; z-index: 30; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 20px; }

.ui-image-workbench__lightbox-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; background: rgb(8 12 20 / .7); backdrop-filter: blur(7px); animation: ui-image-fade var(--motion-standard) ease both; }

.ui-image-workbench__lightbox section { position: relative; width: min(470px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); animation: ui-image-card-in var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease-soft) both; }

.ui-image-workbench__lightbox-close { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 11px; right: 11px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / .55); color: #fff; }
.ui-image-workbench__lightbox-art { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: cover; }
.ui-image-workbench__lightbox footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; }
.ui-image-workbench__lightbox footer strong { display: block; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 13px; }
.ui-image-workbench__lightbox footer span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
@keyframes ui-image-prompt-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(7px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@keyframes ui-image-card-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
@keyframes ui-image-tile-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@keyframes ui-image-result-in { from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(12px); transform: scale(1.07); } to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes ui-image-orb { from { opacity: .13; transform: scale(.6); } to { opacity: .8; transform: scale(1.15); } }

children.css: .ui-image-workbench__panel { position: absolute; z-index: 41; top: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: min(330px, calc(100% - 16px)); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); transform: translateX(12px); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transition: transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s linear var(--motion-standard); }

.ui-image-workbench:not([data-panel-closed]) .ui-image-workbench__panel { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto; transition: transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease), visibility 0s; }
.ui-image-workbench__panel { top: 6px; right: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: min(330px, calc(100% - 12px)); }

.ui-image-workbench, .ui-image-workbench__conversation, .ui-image-workbench__panel, .ui-image-workbench__prompt, .ui-image-workbench__generation, .ui-image-workbench__result, .ui-image-workbench__orb i, .ui-image-workbench__pulse, .ui-image-workbench__tile, .ui-image-workbench__art, .ui-image-workbench__tile-label, .ui-image-workbench__styles button, .ui-image-workbench__lightbox-backdrop, .ui-image-workbench__lightbox section { animation: none; transition: none; }

blocks.css: /* The live route owns the viewport height; the embedded documentation preview keeps its fixed canvas. */
.ui-image-workbench__gallery-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; align-content: start; }
.ui-image-workbench__featured { position: relative; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-image-workbench__featured-art { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.ui-image-workbench__featured-art-image { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; background-size: cover; }

.ui-image-workbench__featured figcaption { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; padding: 40px 12px 12px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgb(0 0 0 / .5)); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; }
.ui-image-workbench__featured-actions { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 9px; right: 9px; display: flex; gap: 5px; }

.ui-image-workbench__featured-actions button, .ui-image-workbench__featured-actions a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 25px; height: 25px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / .55); color: #fff; font-size: 18px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }
.ui-template-board-view__heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 8px; min-height: 50px; padding-inline: 28px; flex: none; }

.ui-template-board-view__heading h2 { flex: 1; min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-strong); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-title-2-medium); font-weight: var(--text-title-2-medium--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-title-2-medium--line-height); letter-spacing: var(--text-title-2-medium--letter-spacing); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-template-board-view__notifications { display: flex; align-items: center; flex: none; }
.ui-template-board-view__actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex: none; }

children.css: .ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board-view__heading { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; min-height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 28px 16px; }

.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-shell > .ui-template-mobile-toggle { top: 42px; right: auto; left: auto; inset-inline-start: 28px; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-color: transparent; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }

.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board-view__heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: 'title notifications' 'tools create'; gap: 12px 8px; padding: 12px 12px 16px; }

blocks.css: .ui-template-board-navigation { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; container: project-board / inline-size; }
.ui-template-board-scroll > .ui-scroll-area__edge:is([data-direction='left'], [data-direction='right']) { inset-block: auto 0; width: 36px; height: 32px; background: none; }

.ui-template-board-navigation__hint { position: absolute; inset-inline: 52px; bottom: 8px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-caption-2-regular); font-weight: var(--text-caption-2-regular--font-weight); line-height: var(--text-caption-2-regular--line-height); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-2-regular--letter-spacing); text-align: center; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--motion-fast) ease, visibility 0s var(--motion-fast); }

children.css: .ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board-navigation .ui-template-board-scroll .ui-template-board { padding: 0 12px 8px; gap: 12px; scroll-padding-inline: 12px; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; }

.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board-scroll .ui-template-board > section,
  .ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board-scroll .ui-template-board[data-compact] > section { flex: 0 0 100%; scroll-snap-align: start; scroll-snap-stop: always; }

blocks.css: .ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board > section { transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--motion-fast) ease; }

.ui-board-drag-overlay { width: 100%; min-height: 0; padding: 12px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--board-card-surface); box-shadow: 0 14px 35px rgb(20 24 35 / .19), 0 2px 8px rgb(20 24 35 / .08); cursor: grabbing; pointer-events: none; }
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-top > span { overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin-top: 6px; }

.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: #dceaff; color: #2461b7; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; font-style: normal; text-transform: capitalize; }

.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; }
.ui-board-drag-overlay h4 { margin: 7px 0 5px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 17px; }

.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board article .ui-template-board__card-top > span,
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-top > span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board article .ui-template-board__card-tags em,
.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board article .ui-template-board__card-tags > span,
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em,
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board article .ui-template-board__card-footer > span,
.ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-footer > span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-board-card__open { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; touch-action: manipulation; }
.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board__card-tags em, .ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em { background: var(--board-low-background); color: var(--board-low-text); }

.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='medium'], .ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='medium'] { background: var(--board-medium-background); color: var(--board-medium-text); }

.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='high'], .ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='high'] { background: var(--board-high-background); color: var(--board-high-text); }

.ui-template-board-application .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='urgent'], .ui-board-drag-overlay .ui-template-board__card-tags em[data-priority='urgent'] { background: var(--board-urgent-background); color: var(--board-urgent-text); }
.ui-board-person-avatar[data-portrait] img { inset: auto; width: 200%; height: 200%; max-width: none; object-fit: fill; }

.ui-board-create { position: relative; width: min(560px, 100%); max-height: calc(100dvh - 56px); overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgb(15 23 42 / .2), 0 2px 10px rgb(15 23 42 / .06); }

.ui-board-create header b { padding: 0 3px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-weight: 400; }

.ui-board-create__title { width: 100%; min-height: 24px; margin-top: 13px; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 17px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-board-create textarea { max-height: 160px; width: 100%; min-height: 24px; height: 24px; resize: none; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; }
.ui-board-create__properties { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-top: 43px; padding: 0; }

.ui-board-create__properties label, .ui-board-create__properties > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 23px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; }
.ui-board-create__properties select { max-width: 115px; border: 0; outline: 0; appearance: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; }
.ui-board-create__select { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }

.ui-board-create__property-trigger { width: auto; min-height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-board-create__keep { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-board-detail { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: min(609px, 100%); min-width: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgb(15 23 42 / .2), 0 2px 10px rgb(15 23 42 / .06); }
.ui-board-detail > header > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.ui-board-detail > header > div:first-child { flex: 0 1 auto; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-board-detail > header > div:first-child span, .ui-board-detail > header > div:first-child strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
