.ui-board-detail__actions-menu .ui-dropdown-item { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-board-detail__scroll { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 24px 8px; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-board-detail__created { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 20px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }
.ui-board-detail h2 { margin: 12px 0 6px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; }
.ui-board-detail__property, .ui-board-detail__resources { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-top: 20px; }
.ui-board-detail__property > span:first-child, .ui-board-detail__resources > span { width: 70px; flex: none; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }
.ui-board-detail__property-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-width: 0; }
.ui-board-detail__selector { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; }

.ui-board-detail__selector-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: auto; min-height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); box-shadow: none; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-board-detail__select-menu { z-index: 120; width: 220px; min-width: 0; max-height: 240px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .04), 0 4px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .02); backdrop-filter: none; }
.ui-board-detail__select-menu .ui-select__option { justify-content: flex-start; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-main); }
.ui-board-detail__select-menu .ui-select__option strong { display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-board-detail__property label, .ui-board-detail__property > span:not(:first-child) { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; }

.ui-board-detail__property select { min-height: 24px; max-width: 120px; padding: 0; border: 0; appearance: none; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }
.ui-board-detail__property em { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: #dceaff; color: #2461b7; font-size: 11px; line-height: 15px; font-style: normal; text-transform: capitalize; }
.ui-board-detail__resources > div { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; }

.ui-board-detail__resources a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; }
.ui-board-detail__chart { min-height: 256px; margin-top: 21px; overflow: hidden; padding: 16px 16px 10px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-board-detail__chart strong { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 20px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-board-detail__chart em { margin-left: 5px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 7px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--chart-violet) 14%, transparent); color: var(--chart-violet); font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; vertical-align: middle; }
.ui-board-detail__chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 149px; margin-top: 13px; overflow: visible; }
.ui-board-detail__chart > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 10px; }
.ui-board-detail__comments { display: grid; align-content: end; gap: 30px; flex: 1; min-height: 130px; padding: 24px 0 20px; }
.ui-board-detail__comments > div { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; }
.ui-board-detail__comments p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-board-detail__comment-form { position: relative; flex: none; min-height: 72px; margin: 0 12px 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-raised); }

.ui-board-detail__comment-form textarea { width: 100%; height: 20px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

.ui-board-detail__comment-form > button { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 25px; height: 25px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-main); }
.ui-board-detail__comment-form > button:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-strong); color: var(--on-accent); cursor: pointer; }
@keyframes ui-board-menu-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

children.css: .ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board > section, .ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board article { animation: none; transition: none; }

blocks.css: .ui-board-search-popover__summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
.ui-board-notifications-popover { width: min(430px, calc(100vw - 24px)); min-width: 0; max-height: calc(100dvh - 100px); overflow: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; }
.ui-calendar__notifications-popover { width: 430px; max-height: min(640px, calc(100dvh - 24px)); overflow-y: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-calendar__inbox > strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); font-weight: 500; }
.ui-calendar__inbox > div { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-calendar__inbox b { color: var(--text-main); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); font-weight: 500; }
.ui-calendar__inbox small, .ui-calendar__inbox p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-2-regular); line-height: 18px; }
.ui-calendar__tools > span { flex: 1; color: var(--text-strong); text-align: center; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); }
.ui-calendar__weekdays, .ui-calendar__days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; }
.ui-calendar__weekdays span { color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; font-size: var(--text-body-2-regular); }
.ui-calendar__events button:hover { filter: saturate(1.3) brightness(.97); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.ui-calendar__events button > span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-calendar__popover-head strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: var(--text-headline-medium); line-height: 22px; font-weight: var(--text-headline-medium--font-weight); }
.ui-calendar__popover-head span { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); }

.ui-calendar__popover-head > button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0; }

.ui-calendar__popover-row small { margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: 16px; font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); }

.ui-calendar__popover-meeting code { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: 16px; font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-calendar__popover-meeting a, .ui-calendar__popover-meeting button { flex: none; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent-strong); color: white; font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-calendar__popover-section-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-calendar__person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-strong); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-calendar__person > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: #d5d8dc; color: #60646b; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-calendar__popover-description { margin: 0; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
@keyframes ui-calendar-appear { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px) scale(.98); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }

children.css: .ui-calendar__events button:not(.ui-calendar__more) { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; min-height: 8px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; }

.ui-calendar__icon-button, .ui-calendar__tools button, .ui-calendar__new, .ui-calendar__day, .ui-calendar__events button, .ui-calendar__popover, .ui-calendar__feed { animation: none; transition: none; }

blocks.css: .ui-composer-loader { position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: var(--loader-radius, 999px); background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-composer-loader__light { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: inherit; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 450ms ease; }
.ui-composer-loader__light rect { animation: ui-loader-rim var(--loader-speed) linear infinite var(--loader-direction); }
.ui-composer-loader .ui-composer__panel { padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--loader-radius); background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
.ui-composer-loader :is(.ui-composer__add, .ui-composer__voice, .ui-composer-model__trigger) { transition: background-color 480ms ease, border-color 480ms ease, box-shadow 480ms ease; }

.ui-composer-loader[data-active] :is(.ui-composer__add, .ui-composer__voice, .ui-composer-model__trigger) { border-color: transparent; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-base) 18%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25), 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .035); backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(160%); }
.ui-composer__entry > textarea { font-size: var(--text-body-regular); line-height: 20px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; transition: height .2s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); }
/* Keep writing space usable when the composer itself is narrow, including in an iframe. */
.ui-composer__status { gap: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: 18px; font-weight: var(--text-body-2-medium--font-weight); }
.ui-composer-add-menu__text { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-composer-add-menu__text strong { flex: none; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); }
.ui-composer-add-menu__text small { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

.ui-composer-add-menu__group button[data-id='documents'] .ui-composer-add-menu__icon,
.ui-composer-add-menu__group button[data-id='spreadsheets'] .ui-composer-add-menu__icon,
.ui-composer-add-menu__group button[data-id='presentations'] .ui-composer-add-menu__icon,
.ui-composer-add-menu__group button[data-id='code'] .ui-composer-add-menu__icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

.ui-composer-model__trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 4px; max-width: 145px; min-height: 31px; padding: 0 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); box-shadow: none; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-composer-model__trigger > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-composer-model__trigger { transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, opacity .15s ease; }
.ui-composer-model__trigger > svg { flex: none; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1); }
.ui-composer-model__popover { width: 266px; max-height: min(420px, calc(100dvh - 24px)); overflow: auto; padding: 10px; border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface-base); }

.ui-composer-model__models .ui-dropdown-group__label { padding: 2px 8px 6px; font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-2-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-2-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-2-medium--letter-spacing); }
.ui-composer-model__option { justify-content: space-between; min-height: 39px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-composer-model__radio { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 15px; height: 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-composer-model__option[aria-pressed='true'] .ui-composer-model__radio::after { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-base); content: ''; }
.ui-composer-model__effort { display: grid; gap: 7px; margin: 9px -10px -10px; padding: 12px 17px 15px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-composer-model__effort > div:nth-child(2) { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 17px; }

.ui-composer-model__range { position: relative; height: 26px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--border-control) var(--effort-progress), var(--surface-muted) var(--effort-progress)); }
.ui-composer-model__ticks { position: absolute; inset: 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; pointer-events: none; }
.ui-composer-model__ticks i { width: 2px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--border-control); }
.ui-composer-model__range input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; appearance: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-composer-model__range input::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 23px; height: 25px; margin-top: .5px; appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }

.ui-composer-model__range input::-moz-range-thumb { width: 23px; height: 25px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }
.ui-composer-panel .ui-composer__panel { min-height: 102px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px .5px rgb(0 0 0 / .02), 0 4px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .02); }
.ui-composer-panel .ui-composer__entry { grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 20px 8px; padding-top: 6px; }
.ui-composer-panel .ui-composer__entry > textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; font-size: var(--text-body-regular); font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; }

.ui-composer-panel .ui-composer-status-tab { width: calc(100% - 56px); height: 34px; min-height: 34px; margin-bottom: 0; padding: 4px 8px; gap: 12px; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-composer-status-tab > span > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-composer-permission__trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex: none; min-height: 30px; height: 30px; max-width: 145px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); box-shadow: none; font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) ease, color var(--motion-fast) ease; }
.ui-composer-permission__popover { width: 323px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 6px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface-base); }

.ui-composer-picker__heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-composer-picker__heading .ui-link-button, .ui-composer-picker__heading .ui-button { height: auto; min-height: 20px; padding: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-composer-permission__options .ui-radio { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) ease; }
.ui-composer-permission__options .ui-radio > span:last-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.ui-composer-permission__options strong { display: block; color: var(--text-main); font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-composer-permission__options small { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: 18px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-composer-provider__popover { width: 341px; height: 282px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px); overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-composer-provider__tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr); height: 100%; min-height: 0; gap: 0; }

.ui-composer-provider__tabs > .ui-tabs__list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; min-height: 0; gap: 6px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-raised); scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-composer-provider__tabs .ui-tabs__tab { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 36px; min-height: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-composer-provider__tabs > .ui-tabs__panel { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; height: 100%; padding: 0; }
.ui-composer-provider__lineup { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; height: 100%; padding: 8px; }
.ui-composer-provider-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

.ui-composer-provider__lineup .ui-composer-picker__heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); justify-content: stretch; gap: 0; flex: none; min-height: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0 4px; }

.ui-chart-barlist__tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; height: 44px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-chart-barlist__tabs button { position: relative; align-self: stretch; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; }
.ui-chart-barlist__tabs button[aria-selected='true']::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent-strong); content: ''; }

.ui-chart-barlist__tabs > span { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-subtle);    font-size: var(--text-caption-1-medium); line-height: var(--text-caption-1-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-caption-1-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-caption-1-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-chart-barlist__row { position: relative; display: flex !important; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; outline-offset: 2px; }

.ui-chart-barlist__row > b { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 0 auto 0 0; height: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: #dbeafa; transform-origin: left; animation: ui-chart-barlist-grow .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both; }
.ui-chart-barlist__row > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-strong); }
@keyframes ui-chart-barlist-grow { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
.ui-chart-card--contributions .ui-chart-summary span { padding: 10px; border-radius: 11px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; }

.ui-chart-card--contributions .ui-chart-summary small { margin: 0;    font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-chart-contributions__activity { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 0 8px 8px; color: var(--text-muted);    font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }
.ui-chart-contributions__activity > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.ui-chart-contributions__activity button { font-weight: 400; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }

.ui-chart-contributions__months { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); justify-items: center; margin: 8px 8px 0; color: var(--text-subtle);    font-size: var(--text-body-2-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-2-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-2-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-2-medium--letter-spacing); }
.ui-chart-card__footer-label > span { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-chart-card--combo .ui-chart-card__footer > div, .ui-chart-card--area .ui-chart-card__footer > div, .ui-chart-card--funnel .ui-chart-card__footer > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-height: 57px; }
.ui-chart-combo-plot svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.ui-chart-card__value small { color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-chart-week-range { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 5px; min-width: 151px; height: 32px; padding: 0 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); color: var(--text-main);   white-space: nowrap;  font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-chart-week-range button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 26px; flex: none; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); cursor: pointer; }
.ui-chart-card--sleep .ui-chart-sleep__details { gap: 0; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-chart-card--sleep .ui-chart-sleep__details > div { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 0; }
.ui-chart-heatmap-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 31px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: stretch; gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }
.ui-chart-heatmap-days { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(7, 1fr); align-items: center; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
.ui-chart-heatmap-hours { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 6px 0 0 36px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
.ui-chart-month-label { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 20px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; }
.ui-chart-month-label__value { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.ui-chart-days-viewport { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; padding-inline: 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); }

.ui-chart-card--days .ui-chart-days { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0; max-height: none; overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; scrollbar-width: none; animation: none; }

.ui-chart-card--days .ui-chart-days > .ui-chart-days__months { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 16px; min-height: 0; padding: 10px 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; }
.ui-chart-days__month h3 { margin: 0; padding-left: 4px; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 16px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-chart-days__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 5px; }

.ui-chart-days__day { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; height: 78px; padding: 10px 0; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1); }
.ui-chart-card--days .ui-chart-rings--small { width: min(28px, 100%); height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; margin: 0; flex: none; }

children.css: .ui-chart-card--activity-rings .ui-chart-ring-legend > div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; }

blocks.css: .ui-chart-radial-rings { display: block; width: 220px; max-width: 72%; height: 220px; margin: 12px auto 12px; }

.ui-chart-card--radial .ui-chart-card__footer, .ui-chart-card--radar .ui-chart-card__footer, .ui-chart-card--stage .ui-chart-card__footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.ui-chart-card--stage .ui-chart-stage > div > span { color: var(--text-muted); text-align: right; }

.ui-chart-card--funnel .ui-chart-card__footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }

children.css:

blocks.css: /* Preview spacing belongs to the documentation frame, not the chart itself. */
.ui-chart-card--steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; height: 330px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 20px; }

.ui-steps-day { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: default; }
.ui-steps-day__track { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; flex: 1; width: min(50px, calc(100% - 12px)); min-height: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-steps-day__track::after { position: absolute; inset: -4px; border: 2px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 14px; content: ''; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; }
.ui-steps-day__fill { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--chart-teal); transition: filter 150ms ease-out; }
.ui-steps-day__label { flex: none; height: 26px; padding-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; }
/* Keep the week control anchored while the hover value changes on narrow cards. */
.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; padding: 0 28px 9px 24px; scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board > section { position: relative; flex: 0 0 273px; height: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px 6px 6px; border-radius: 20px; scroll-snap-align: start; }
.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board > section > header { height: 20px; min-height: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding-inline: 6px; }
.ui-template-board-view .ui-template-board > section > header > span { padding: 0; background: transparent; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 400; }
.ui-theme-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; padding: 3px; border-radius: 19px; background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-theme-switch button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-theme-switch button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }

.ui-image-agent-shell { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 242px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; height: 760px; min-width: 0; padding: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-base); }

.ui-agent-sidebar__search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; flex: none; min-height: 34px; margin-top: 13px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-subtle); }
.ui-agent-sidebar__search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; }
.ui-agent-sidebar__search kbd { flex: none; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-subtle); font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; }
.ui-agent-sidebar__notice { position: relative; margin: 0 0 8px; padding: 8px 23px 8px 9px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-agent-sidebar__notice button { position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 4px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 17px; }
.ui-dash { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 16px; min-width: 0; padding-bottom: 20px; }

.ui-template-home__popover { position: absolute; z-index: 25; top: 82px; right: 0; width: min(430px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }
.ui-template-home__popover--filters strong { padding: 4px 7px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-template-home__popover--filters button { min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }
.live-template .ui-template-multi { grid-template-columns: 260px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.live-template .ui-template-multi > aside { padding: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 23px; }
.live-template .ui-template-multi > aside h3 { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.live-template .ui-template-multi > aside button > span { width: 35px; height: 35px; border-radius: 10px; }
.ui-dash-header__breadcrumbs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-dash-header__breadcrumbs > span:not(.ui-dash-header__avatar), .ui-dash-header__breadcrumbs strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

.ui-dash-header__avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 21px; height: 21px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-label); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.ui-dash-header__row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 38px; }

.ui-dash-header h1 { min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 21px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.025em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-dash-header__icon, .ui-dash-header__control { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; flex: none; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; }

.ui-dash-header__icon i { position: absolute; top: -5px; right: -5px; display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 15px; height: 15px; padding-inline: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ed2443; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; }

.ui-dash-header__popover, .ui-dash-header__filters { position: absolute; z-index: 25; top: 80px; right: 0; width: min(430px, calc(100vw - 36px)); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }
.ui-dash-header__filters button { padding: 8px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }

.ui-dash .ui-stat-card { container: dashboard-stat / inline-size; display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: 35px 22px 34px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; min-height: 132px; padding: 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface-raised); }

.ui-dash .ui-stat-card__icon, .ui-dash .ui-stat-card[data-color] .ui-stat-card__icon { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 1; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-strong); }
.ui-dash .ui-stat-card__label { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

.ui-dash .ui-stat-card > strong { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; align-self: center; margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 25px; line-height: 31px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.035em; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-dash .ui-stat-card__foot { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; align-self: center; justify-self: start; min-height: 0; margin: 0 0 0 8px; padding: 0; background: transparent; }
.ui-dash__triple { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.ui-dash__double { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.ui-dash .ui-chart-card { border: 0; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: none; background: var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-dash-spend { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-dash-spend > header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.ui-dash-spend > header strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 24px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-dash-spend > header em { padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--success-soft, #e1f7b5); color: var(--success-strong, #508514); font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; }

.ui-dash-spend > header button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; flex: none; height: 30px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 11px; }
.ui-dash-spend__meter { position: relative; align-self: center; width: min(240px, 100%); height: 143px; margin: 6px 0 0; }
.ui-dash-spend__meter > div { position: absolute; inset: 61px 0 auto; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0; }
.ui-dash-spend__meter strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-dash-spend footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px 13px; margin-top: auto; }
.ui-dash-spend footer > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 5px; align-items: center; }
.ui-dash-spend footer span { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-dash-spend footer strong { grid-column: 2; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-dash-channels__header { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-inline: -16px; padding-inline: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
.ui-dash-channels__tabs { align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 36px; min-width: 0; border: 0; }
.ui-dash-channels__tabs .ui-tabs__tab { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 400; }
.ui-dash-channels__indicator { position: absolute; bottom: 0; inset-inline: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent-strong); }

.ui-dash-channels__header > span { flex: none; padding-bottom: 10px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ui-dash-channels__rows > div { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; }
.ui-dash-channels__rows > div > span { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--chart-blue) 14%, transparent); }
.ui-dash-channels__rows strong, .ui-dash-channels__rows em { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-style: normal; }
.ui-dash-channels__rows strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 400; }
.ui-dash-channels__rows em { flex: none; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ui-dash-patient, .ui-dash-alerts { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; padding: 10px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-raised); }
.ui-dash-patient__identity { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 14px; height: 136px; }
.ui-dash-patient__identity :is(h2, h3) { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 20px; line-height: 25px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-dash-patient__details > div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 9px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); font-size: 13px; }
.ui-dash-patient__details strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-strong); font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-dash-alerts > header { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 4px; min-height: 80px; padding: 4px 5px; color: var(--text-muted);   font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-dash-alerts > header strong { color: var(--text-strong);    font-size: var(--text-title-1-medium); line-height: var(--text-title-1-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-title-1-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-title-1-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-dash-alerts > header small { color: var(--text-muted);    font-size: var(--text-body-2-regular); line-height: var(--text-body-2-regular--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-2-regular--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-2-regular--letter-spacing); }
.ui-dash-alerts > div { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-height: 229px; overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-dash-alerts article { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; justify-items: start; gap: 4px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-base); }
.ui-dash-alerts article time { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; justify-self: end; }
.ui-dash-alerts article i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 29px; height: 29px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ed2354; color: white; font-style: normal; }

.ui-dash-alerts article strong {    font-size: var(--text-body-medium); line-height: var(--text-body-medium--line-height); font-weight: var(--text-body-medium--font-weight); letter-spacing: var(--text-body-medium--letter-spacing); }

.ui-dash-dialog { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(440px, 100%); padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }

.ui-profile-card__cover { height: 165px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(38 66 120 / .12), transparent 55%), var(--appui-profile-cover, url('/carousel/coral-arch.webp')) center 48% / cover no-repeat; }
.ui-profile-card__identity { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: start; min-height: 113px; padding-top: 48px; }

.ui-profile-agents > header > div:last-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; }

.ui-profile-agents > footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; }
.ui-chat-starter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0; }
.ui-chat-starter__conversation > header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; height: 53px; flex: none; padding: 0 16px; }

.ui-chat-starter__conversation > header button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-subtle); }

.ui-chat-starter__thread { display: flex; flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 18px; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ui-chat-starter__empty { display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

.ui-chat-starter__empty button { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 19px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; }
.ui-chat-starter__empty button:hover { color: var(--text-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.ui-chat-starter__messages { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; width: 100%; min-height: min-content; margin-top: auto; padding-bottom: 20px; }

.ui-chat-starter__messages > div { max-width: min(540px, 88%); padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; white-space: pre-wrap; }

.ui-chat-starter__composer form { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 54px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 29px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); }

.ui-chat-starter__composer form > button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: none; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-strong); }
.ui-chat-starter__composer form > button:last-child { background: var(--accent-strong); color: var(--on-accent); }
.ui-chat-starter__composer form > button:disabled { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-subtle); cursor: default; }
.ui-chat-starter__composer form > input[type='text'] { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 14px; }
.ui-chat-starter__composer > footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; }
.ui-chat-starter__composer > footer button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; }

.ui-chat-starter__attached { margin-top: 7px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.ui-chat-starter__history { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; }

.ui-chat-starter__history > button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 29px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); text-align: left; font-size: 14px; }
.ui-chat-starter__history > div { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 4px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; }

.ui-chat-starter__history > div button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main); text-align: left; }
.ui-chat-starter__history > div button[aria-current='page'], .ui-chat-starter__history > div button:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); }
.ui-chat-starter__history > div strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ui-chat-starter__history > div small { color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

.ui-chat-starter__history > footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); color: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; }
.ui-chat-starter__history > footer span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); }

.ui-multi-chat__sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-canvas); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sidebar); }

.ui-multi-chat__agents > button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 54px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-strong); text-align: left; transition: background-color 180ms; }

.ui-multi-chat__account > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-strong); color: white; }
.ui-multi-chat__main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-canvas); }

.ui-multi-chat__current { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 70%; padding: 5px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; text-align: left; }
.ui-multi-chat__thread { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 16px 12px; overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }

.ui-multi-chat__day { align-self: center; margin: 4px 0; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }
.ui-multi-chat__empty { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 12px; flex: 1; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ui-multi-chat__empty h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 20px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 500; }

.ui-multi-chat__editor { position:relative; min-width:0; min-height:0; overflow:hidden; visibility:hidden; opacity:0; transform:translateX(8px); transition:opacity var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease),transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease),visibility 0s var(--motion-standard); }

.ui-multi-chat__scrim { position:absolute; z-index:50; inset:0; border:0; background:rgb(9 13 22 / 0); backdrop-filter:blur(3px); visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none; transition:background-color var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease),visibility 0s var(--motion-standard); }

children.css: .ui-multi-chat__editor { position: absolute; z-index: 51; inset: 12px 12px 12px auto; width: min(356px, calc(100% - 24px)); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-menu); }

.ui-multi-chat__sidebar { position: absolute; z-index: 51; inset: 12px auto 12px 12px; width: min(280px, calc(100% - 24px)); visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(-110%); transition:transform var(--motion-standard) var(--motion-ease),visibility 0s var(--motion-standard); }

blocks.css: .ui-pricing-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 200; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; overflow-y: auto; background: rgb(0 0 0 / .68); }

.ui-pricing-modal { width: min(100%, 1060px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 48px); overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 40px; background: var(--surface-base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }

.ui-pricing-plan__price > strong { color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 42px; letter-spacing: -.9px; }
.ui-pricing-plan__price > span { max-width: 180px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }
.ui-pricing-plan > ul { display: grid; align-content: start; flex: 1; gap: 18px; margin: 0; padding: 24px 20px; list-style: none; border-radius: 23px; background: var(--surface-base); }

.ui-paywall-action :is(.ui-button,.ui-link-button) { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; height: auto; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; white-space: normal; text-align: center; }

.ui-pricing-dialog__footnote { margin: 24px 0 0; color: var(--text-subtle); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; text-align: center; }

.ui-pricing-install h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong); font-size: 20px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 500; }
